title: New Smart Factory Insights Solution from Belden and Edge2Web helps manufacturers eliminate costly downtime
summary: New solution powered by AWS IoT SiteWise combines Belden's industrial data infrastructure with Edge2Web's analytics to turn plant floor data into faster, smarter operational decisions
body_markdown:
**ST. LOUIS, Mo. – October 1, 2026** – Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC), a leading global provider of complete connection solutions, today announced the new Belden and Edge2Web Smart Factory Insights solution, powered by AWS IoT SiteWise. The solution helps manufacturers drive continuous improvement across the plant floor by digitizing operations and visualizing key performance indicators (KPIs).


Manufacturers are under pressure to improve efficiency, but turning plant floor data into action remains difficult. Many operations still run on a patchwork of control systems and manual processes that make real-time performance visibility hard to achieve.


The solution delivers:


- No-code tools to create custom KPIs, dashboards and scorecards without programming
- Multi-protocol support connecting more than 300 industrial protocols and device types
- GenAI-powered summaries, alerts and digital playbooks for faster decision-making
- Scalability from single-site deployments to global, multi-site operations


The Belden and Edge2Web Smart Factory Insights solution combines Belden Horizon™ Data Operations with Edge2Web Factory Insights. Belden Horizon™ Data Operations connects more than 300 industrial protocols and normalizes plant data acquisition and secure transmission to AWS IoT SiteWise. Edge2Web Factory Insights, a software-as-a-service application, computes and visualizes key performance indicators such as overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), total effective equipment performance (TEEP), mean time between failures and mean time to repair (MTBF/MTTR), and energy consumption.


“Most manufacturers are not lacking data. They are missing the connection from data to decisions, and getting there usually means stitching together three or four vendors and hoping it holds together. We built this solution with Edge2Web powered by AWS so that work is done and customers can realize value quickly – and it’s the first in a line of end-to-end solutions we’re bringing to market with our ecosystem partners to deliver customer outcomes,” said David Ricks, Ecosystem Partner Program Manager, Belden.


“Manufacturing leaders need end-to-end solutions that enable reduced downtime, improved product quality, and optimized energy utilization. By combining best-in-class edge data acquisition with advanced performance analytics and AI, Belden and Edge2Web are partnering to address complex manufacturing challenges quickly and at scale,” said Fred Holahan, Co-Founder and CEO, Edge2Web, Inc.


The Edge2Web collaboration reflects Belden's ongoing evolution from a connectivity products provider to a comprehensive solutions provider, helping manufacturers move from raw plant floor data to the insights that drive operational performance. Learn more about[Belden and Edge2Web Smart Factory Insights](https://solutions.belden.com/your-machines-know) .

#### About Edge2Web


Edge2Web delivers AI-assisted smart manufacturing applications, data visualization tools, and application development solutions to industrial customers worldwide. Edge2Web solutions are used in crop science, food & beverage, consumer packaged goods, automotive, industrial machinery, pharma, aviation, power & energy, oil & gas, and other industrial sectors. Edge2Web solutions run natively on leading industrial IoT data platforms – AWS IoT SiteWise and Siemens Insights Hub. Edge2Web solutions form the foundation of many of the world’s most widely deployed industrial IoT production systems. Companies such as Bayer Crop Science, Arca Continental, Founders Brewing Company, and Nedschroef Machinery use Edge2Web to power their digital industrial strategies. Edge2Web is based in Connecticut, USA and London, UK.
